title: NaBr flame-test coverage and CEA trial nonconvergence
original_physical_forecast: Compare the declared emission signatures of NaCl, NaBr and KCl and check that a flame-test event does not consume each salt as fuel. An unparameterised salt must be reported as such rather than assigned a guessed line.

event.detail: cea-thermal could not solve this state: equilibrium did not converge after 1 iterations

generic_limit: An exit0 is not accepted chemistry. No new runtime, parameter change or calibration is assigned.
observed: NaCl and KCl yield bright-yellow/lilac flame_test events. NaBr yields solver_failed plus did_not_ignite (no_fuel), with no flame_test. The complete bench before/after NaBr ignition is identical: each salt retains 0.1 g at 298.15 K, with zero excess enthalpy. Fuel combustion was not expected. The original shared-sodium optical forecast is not met.
source_domain: Registry optical/NaBr has flame_colour=null, whereas NaCl/KCl supply flame metadata. NoFuel is an honest combustion result but does not answer the missing flame-test observable. CEA applies above its kinetic threshold when charge maps; solver admission/pool and optical-property coverage must be reviewed separately. Do not invent sodium emission data or infer noncombustible means no flame colour.
acceptance_lanes: Separate optical property coverage from hot equilibrium/combustion admission; preserve raw nonconvergence and unsupported property evidence.
Require supported NaCl/KCl behavior unchanged; either review-source NaBr flame metadata or state explicit missing optical coverage. Do not invent rates, heat or flame data.
Validate no-fuel ignition restores inventory/temperature and never leaves spark heat or trial products; supported/missing-element pool paths report honest scope.
